name: claude-statusline
description: Claude Code limits, session context and spend in the VS Code status bar

claudeStatusline.refreshInterval.description: How often to refresh limits and session stats, in seconds.

claudeStatusline.alignment.description: Which side of the status bar to use. Requires a window reload.

claudeStatusline.priority.description: Priority within the chosen side: higher means further left. Requires a window reload.
